image_description: A close-up view of a grey whale surfacing in blue water. The image focuses on the whale's head and upper back, showing the characteristic mottled grey skin covered in white barnacles and cyamids (whale lice). The arched rostrum is visible breaking the surface, but the blowholes are obscured by the angle and water. No dorsal fin is present, consistent with the species, though the dorsal knuckles are not clearly defined in this specific crop. The flippers and tail flukes are outside the frame.
